steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: That's two arms, two legs, two eyes, two ears, one nose, all present and accounted for. Maybe a bit of a tan?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Thank goodness! You have you no idea how anxious I was when I heard these bandits were stone-cold killers who ate people for breakfast!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: And who told you THAT?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Do you know how much courage I had to muster to come here and rescue you? Weedy's still back at town. I'll get in touch with her.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Whisper) Whenever you're ready, I'll call her, and we can get out of here!

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I've tried, it's practically impossible. Besides, I don't plan on leaving for now.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Why not? Don't tell me you actually joined up with these bandits like they say?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Whisper) Come on, out with it. Or do you really think there's a future out here with these backwater thugs?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: ...I have no interest in becoming a pirate, Elysium.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I'm staying because... I want to resume the alchemical research I ran from. This compass has Corazonix in it, maybe the last one.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Besides... I promised them I would fix it. It's critical for their survival.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: So... you plan to stay with them?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: No. Once it's fixed, they'll leave the Salt Flat for the ocean.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Then I'll stay behind and continue to hone my skills in both swordplay and alchemy.
Elysium pats Isidro on the shoulder. His friend seems to have changed.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Sounds like you've had a lot to think about... Well, that's not such a bad thing.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: So what exactly did the girl outside want me to do here again?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I needed an assistant as I repair the compass.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Just like back in Rhodes Island, then. Let me know what you need.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: I will.
Isidro stands before the transmutation table. The probe in his hand makes a sharp sound as it swipes through the air, an Arts energy field forming along the lines that it draws.
He carefully removes the outer casing of the compass and places it on the table. The viscous substance inside begins to liquify, creating waves in the direction of the energy flow.
Arts energy and Corazonix intertwine into a golden light illuminating the salt flat outside through the gaps in the workshop walls.
The sailors have never seen anything like it. They begin to gather one by one.

steps.name: Peeping Sailor
steps.text: What are they doing in there?

steps.name: Curious Sailor
steps.text: That kid from outside is doing his thing, that owl-kemmie or whatever... Never though it'd glow gold like that though.

steps.name: Peeking Sailor
steps.text: Lemmesee, lemmesee...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Not gonna lie, this is pretty sick. What's that in your hand?

steps.name: Curious Passerby
steps.text: What's that in his hand?

steps.name: Scoffing Passerby
steps.text: Some beggar's magic trick, what else?

steps.name: Curious Passerby
steps.text: Oh. Well, nothing to see here then. It's not like we have any food to spare.

steps.name: Scoffing Passerby
steps.text: Bothersome brat...

steps.name: Young Isidro
steps.text: Come and see my trick! All I ask is a piece of bread—

steps.name: Young Isidro
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Aloof Passerby
steps.text: Get lost, you're in the way.

steps.name: Young Isidro
steps.text: (Whisper) Bastard...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Er, we're attracting quite a crowd outside. Does that bother you?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Want me to chase them away?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: It's fine. With you here chatting away, it feels like I'm right back at Rhodes Island. They won't bother me.
Isidro's hands do not stop. The probe in his hand seems to dance with the Corazonix rippling in the energy field.
His palms emit light, looking to the sailors peeping through the windows like a mirage born of hunger and thirst.

steps.name: Peeping Sailor
steps.text: You ever seen anything like it?

steps.name: Curious Sailor
steps.text: Way back when, I remember the boss talking about folks who'd perform tricks for others in the big cities. Guess that's what it looks like?

steps.name: Peeking Sailor
steps.text: It's beautiful...

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: Let them watch. Just make sure they don't barge in and try to sell me for food.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: ...Sounds weirdly plausible. Do people do that?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: People do a lot of things when there's nothing to eat.

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: Excuse me...

steps.name: Young Isidro
steps.text: Do you have any food?

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: No... will you take this ribbon though?

steps.name: Young Isidro
steps.text: No, it's got to be something I can eat.

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: I don't have anything to eat myself... I...

steps.name: Kind Passerby
steps.text: I happen to have a few biscuits here. Why don't you let this young lady see your trick?

steps.name: Young Isidro
steps.text: Biscuits? Sure, since you asked.
Metal begins to flow in young Isidro's palm, glowing with fantastical colors in the darkness.
Passersby cannot help but gather around. The disdain in their words cannot disguise the fact that their eyes are glued to the light in the young boy's hand.
It has been so long since there was something so bright on these streets.

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: It's so pretty. Can I take a closer look?

steps.name: Young Isidro
steps.text: Suit yourself.
The boy waves his fingers, and the flowing metal turns into a fowlbeast that takes to the air before returning to his palm in the shape of a fin, then a musbeast, then a burdenbeast...
The metallic burdenbeast runs through the crowd, shiny and chrome, leaving behind stardust in the air.

steps.name: Curious Passerby
steps.text: Wow!

steps.name: Scoffing Passerby
steps.text: It's just—

steps.name: Curious Passerby
steps.text: Oh, shut up and watch.

steps.name: Aloof Passerby
steps.text: When was the last time I saw fireworks...

steps.name: Aloof Passerby
steps.text: I think it was a long, long time ago...

steps.name: Shy Child
steps.text: Fireworks? What are fireworks?
The child musters the courage to reach out and catch a burst of drifting starlight. She trembles at the warmth upon her fingertips.

steps.name: Kind Passerby
steps.text: Impressive, boy. It's not often that the people here have something to smile about.

steps.name: Young Isidro
steps.text: Just trying to earn my bread.

steps.name: Kind Passerby
steps.text: Is that so?

steps.name: Kind Passerby
steps.text: Why do you have a smile on your face, then?
The probe guides the Corazonix, drawing a river of stars in the air.
More and more sailors gather, pressing their faces to the window, the thirst, hunger and exhaustion on their faces temporarily replaced by awe and wonder.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Now you're just showing off.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Did you think I couldn't tell?

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: That was just a check of the alchemy equipment and compass. Now comes the next step: separating the rusted and denatured parts from the Corazonix.

steps.name: Isidro
steps.text: This is what I promised them... what I can do for them.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: You two sure spent a long time chatting.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well, it's been a while since we last saw each other. Were you sitting out here this whole time, boss?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: You can stop calling me boss. All my friends call me Peludita, on account of how fluffy I am.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh, so we're friends now?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: 'Course we are! Could you have ever found your old amigo without the help of yours truly?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Talk about twisting the truth.)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hm... so what should you call me, now that we're friends?

spans.text: Hm... so what should you call

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Anything you like! More importantly, what did Señor Isidro say?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: About, you know, putting me under his protection?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Oh, I forgot to ask. But maybe I'll remember tomorrow, if you ask nicely.

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Please, o honorable Señor Pelirrojito! The greatest, handsomest Liberi of all!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Ooh, I like that. Keep it coming!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: (You flipping finshit!)

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: (I'm yanking that red bit right out once I'm out of this mess!)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Well, I guess I do owe you one for helping me find my good buddy...

spans.text: owe you one for helping me find my good buddy...

steps.text: Elysium pats the girl on the head. Her youthful, childlike exterior belies the maturity, even cruelty, lying beneath.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You sure keep some choice company for a girl your age. Well, come find me if you ever squeeze yourself into something you can't squeeze out of.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I'm as kind-hearted as they come, after all!

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: Hmph! Who'd believe a show-off like you?

steps.name: Pascuala
steps.text: At the end of the day, the only one you can trust is yourself.

steps.name: Hungry Sailor
steps.text: Another one, please.

steps.name: Hungry Sailor
steps.text: That pancake... mm... another plate please!

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: (Whisper) Have they never eaten in their entire lives?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: (Whisper) Isn't it all so very familiar? The pride, the gluttony, the greed.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: (Whisper) How are they any different from when they raided your granary?

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: (Whisper) I don't need them to change.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Ahem... I'm sure you're familiar with Aarón, even if your previous visits have been, shall we say, less peaceful.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Still, I bid you welcome, and look forward to a productive discussion.

steps.name: Satisfied Sailor
steps.text: *Burp*—

steps.name: Satisfied Sailor
steps.text: (Raises arm)

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Did you need a handkerchief?

steps.name: Satisfied Sailor
steps.text: I'm good, got my sleeves.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: ...Very well.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: (Whisper) Who decided to serve them fried garlic pancakes?

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: (Whisper) Do you truly believe you can accept them?

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: (Whisper) If it benefits the town.

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Now that you have eaten, it's time to talk—

steps.name: Satisfied Sailor
steps.text: Can we get some more of those for take-out?

steps.name: Silver
steps.text: Dinner is over. It's time to—

steps.name: Satisfied Sailor
steps.text: Alright, you over there, no need to hide. Come here, and we'll talk.

steps.name: Satisfied Sailor
steps.text: Yes, you, señor. You're the one calling the shots, right? You can't fool us.

steps.name: Anastasio
steps.text: ...Negotiation is the calificador's duty. Speak to Señor Silver.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: How long have you been waiting here, Javi?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Since morning.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Didn't Teach tell you I had private business I needed to attend to?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: In all my time by your side, you've never had 'private business' even once. Do you even have a life outside this fleet?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I never said I did.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: So why were you looking for me?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: ...Would you give up the compass, if we found another way besides going out to sea?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I'm listening.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: The mates who got back from Aarón said we'll be pardoned if we hand over the compass and the thief. That they'd let us live in town, or go wherever we want.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: And you believe them?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: I looked into it. The offer's real, at least.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: When? And why wasn't I informed?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Didn't want to bother you while you were recuperating.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: ...And who asked you to be so protective of me?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: How else would I treat the woman who raised me?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: It feels like it was only yesterday. Now you're taller than I am.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: When I was little, I used to pray to grow up faster, taller, and stronger, so that I could share your burden.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: Guess my wish came true.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: You'll always be that little boy to me, no matter how big you are.

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: But what about my thoughts? Will you still treat them as the ideas of a little boy?

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: No, Javi, I won't. I know it's a feeble concession, the kind that only an adult can make.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: But I'd sooner die than surrender to them.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: How many of the friends you grew up with have already died at their hands?

steps.name: Javier
steps.text: I'll never forget, Señora Juana...

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: My crew and I did everything for them, when times were hardest!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: Cruz, myself, and our crew fought the Seaborn to protect them!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: We spared what little rations we had, so they wouldn't have to feed on their own corpses!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: And how did they repay us? By chasing us into the Salt Flat as soon as the Inquisition arrived!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: That never would've happened to Cruz if they hadn't turned a blind eye!

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I will never bow my head to those ingrates.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: I love you, Javi, all of you, whether you believe it or not. Just as I loved all the mates who fought alongside me amidst the waves.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: They're long gone, but I still see them in you all. The legacy of blood works in such mysterious ways.

steps.name: Juana
steps.text: That's why I can never forgive them... I hope you understand.
